Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is presented with a certificate and a plaque, and the room erupts in applause.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Pleasure To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live To The One And Only JASPER JENKINS!

Jasper Smiles, Tears Welling Up In His Eyes As He Accepts The Award.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper Lies In Bed, The Certificate And Plaque Displayed On His Nightstand. He Looks Up At The Ceiling, A Faraway Look In His Eyes.

JASPER (V.O)
I Remember Reading About This Theory When I Was Young. Quantum Immortality. The Idea That Every Time A Person Dies, The Universe Creates A New Branch, A New Reality, Where They Survived.

Jasper's Voice Becomes More Urgent, His Words Spilling Out In A Rush.

JASPER (V.O)
I Always Thought It Was Just A Theory, A Fanciful Idea. But Now, As I Lie Here, Holding This Award, I Wonder... What If It's True?

Jasper's Eyes Glaze Over, His Mind Racing With The Implications.

JASPER (V.O)
What If I'm Not Really Dead? What If I'm Just... Branching Out?

Jasper's Voice Drops To A Whisper, His Words Becoming A Prayer.

JASPER (V.O)
Oh, God, Is This True? Am I Just A Branch Of You?

Suddenly, Jasper's Body Begins To Shake, His Eyes Rolling Back In His Head. He Starts To Crawl Out Of Bed, His Hands Reaching Out Like Tentacles.

JASPER (V.O)
I Have To Find The Other Branches! I Have To Find The Other Me!

The Camera Zooms Out As Jasper's Body Continues To Shake, His Voice Becoming A Frenzied Chant.

JASPER (V.O)
I'M NOT DEAD! I'M NOT DEAD! I'M JUST A BRANCH!

The Screen Fades To Black As Jasper's Manic Cries Echo Through The Night.

FADE OUT.
